I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread to confirm I've noted the deadline: the signed Quarrendon Freight Lines order form is due 7 October.

I also pointed out that today is 16 October, so that date has already passed. I asked her to tell me if she meant a later date or if the form is already in.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. The deadline is a signing date, not a money figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel.
